notes: Project compatibility-entry coverage includes basic remote object references, synonym statements, explain plan statements, national string literals, national q-quoted strings, session-state statements, and INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RETURNING INTO with N>=1 targets paired by ordinal with exactly N colon-prefixed host binds. BULK COLLECT, receivers other than colon-prefixed binds, and unequal list lengths are excluded; the same insert_column patch inserts both sides. The MERGE INSERT project contract independently inserts target columns and VALUES cells through insert_column, or inserts both together; it materializes an omitted target list, independently replaces existing columns and cells, and requires equal widths only when an explicit target list exists at batch completion, with atomic rollback on failure. Paired deletion is unchanged, and MERGE INSERT DEFAULT VALUES is excluded from this mutation. Undelimited sources leave the C flags false and omit the View keys; relation and DML-column patches recompute flags from the new source, and U& quoted identifiers are outside this contract. Relation-bearing Oracle-compatible DDL uses a ddl root block with target/reference roles and exact schema/object delimiter flags; query-backed CREATE objects link targets to separate SELECT blocks through source_block. Only fixture-verified forms are included. All 250 cases have status = "final" and contain 828 independent patches. This is executable project-contract evidence, not a claim that Vastbase server documentation defines the same syntax scope.
